cards:
A computer network is an interconnection of computers and peripheral devices.
目的 Purpose：to exchange information and share hardware and software resources（交换信息、共享软硬件资源）。
网络的好处与坏处 / Pros & cons of networks

Pros: share files/printers/software/Internet access；fast communication；centralised backup；lower cost.
Cons: security risks (hacking, malware spreading through network)；cost of hardware & administration；if server/key device fails, many users are affected.

Local Area Network (LAN): a network that covers a small geographical area such as a home or small office（家、学校、小办公室）。
特点：coverage small，setup cost low，data transfer rate high。

Wide Area Network (WAN): a network that consists of many LANs and covers a large geographical area, such as districts and countries. 互联网 Internet 就是最大的 WAN。
特点：coverage large，setup cost high，data transfer rate lower。
误解：LAN/WAN 只看覆盖范围？

✗ “The difference between a LAN and a WAN depends solely on the coverage area.”
✓ 取决于设备如何连接：once computers are connected through an ISP, they can form a WAN even in a smaller coverage area。因为长距离用电缆直连很困难，所以通常说 WAN 覆盖范围大。
客户端-服务器网络 / Client-server network

A centralised administrative system (server) is present. All resources are stored in a server and shared among the clients connected to it. 访问控制与共享资源由 administrator 管理。
Server provides specific network services；clients = devices that request services from the server。服务器通常比普通电脑更强大、更可靠，专门运行服务。
服务器种类 / Types of servers

• Web server：hosts web pages incl. multimedia files（需较大存储）
  • Game server：多台设备玩多人在线游戏
  • Print server：在网络上共享打印机
  • File server：集中存放共享文件
  • Application server：hosts web-based applications，用户毋须在每部电脑安装（e.g. Google Docs, Office 365）；需较高运算能力
Devices share resources without a centralised administrative system. 每个用户自行分享文件；设备之间using dedicated software 直接互相连接和请求。例子：BitTorrent 下载。

Client-serverP2P
ProsMore secure (user management by administrator)；easier to keep consistency of resource versions；easier backup & recoveryLower cost (no server)；easier to set up (no server knowledge)；higher flexibility to add/remove devices
ConsHigher server setup & maintenance cost；harder to set up/maintain；service stops once the server is downLess secure (no centralised management)；dedicated software required；hard to control versions of resources
同一部电脑可同时是 server 和 client
例：电脑 A 用 USB 连打印机并共享给全班 → 对打印而言它是 print server；同时它浏览网页 → 它是 web client。角色由“提供服务/请求服务”决定，不由硬件决定。
常见网络服务 / Common network services

• Internal communications
  • Conferencing
  • Resource sharing：file sharing、hardware sharing、software sharing、Internet access service sharing

网络让电脑直接通讯：Efficiency（坐在电脑前即可沟通）、Convenience（只要连网即无限制）、Privacy（only the intended recipient receives the message）。
公司为保密，机密讯息不经 Internet，而经 Intranet 传送 → internal communication（例：command prompt 发讯息）。

Real-time collaboration with audio and video communication for users at different locations.
质量取决于 data transmission rate (bandwidth, bps)；带宽低 → 影音质量差。视频通常先 compressed 再传送。提升质量：用更高数据传输率的网络、更高解像度的镜头（但也需更高带宽）。

SOHO (Small Office/Home Office) 网络中经网络共享文件和打印机。
Administrator 在 network server 建 folder 并设 access control：read only / read and write / full control。用户以 network drive / NAS (Network-attached Storage) 存取。
集中存储于服务器的好处

• Maintains consistency of data for multiple devices
  • 本机数据可删除以 save storage space
  • 多人同时处理同一 folder → efficiency
  • Facilitates the backup process；可协助 recover local data
共享 printer、scanner、file server 等，充分利用硬件、减少购置成本。
网络打印机：USB 接电脑 vs 直接接网络

Method A：打印机用 USB 接电脑 A 再共享
Adv: easy to set up and control. Disadv: printer usable only when computer A is on；A 的 CPU/RAM 被占用 → runs slower。
Method B：打印机用 UTP 线直接接网络（network printer 自己处理 authentication、printing quota、job priority）；不依赖任何一部电脑。
把软件装在中央 server，员工用 remote logon 轮流远程使用 → save software licensing cost，不必每部电脑安装，资源用得更有效率。
互联网连接共享 / Internet access service sharing

一部已连网的设备把连线分享给 LAN 内其他设备 → reduces cost of service；亦可 monitor and control incoming/outgoing traffic 保护内部电脑。例：pocket Wi-Fi、Windows mobile hotspot（设定 SSID 与 password）、手机经 Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/USB 分享 mobile data。
判断 client-server 还是 P2P 服务
老师电脑共享打印机给全班 → client-server（老师机是 print server）。老师电脑共享 folder 让学生交功课 → client-server（file server）。学生用 command prompt 直接发讯息给另一学生 → peer-to-peer。

A NIC connects a device to a network and allows it to communicate, using cables or wirelessly.
Ethernet NIC：有插 Ethernet cable 的 slot (RJ-45)。Wireless NIC：通常有 antennae 以改善收讯。

每张 NIC 有 48-bit unique Media Access Control (MAC) address，used to identify a device connected to a network。
Assigned by device manufacturers and stored in the hardware（不像 IP 可改变）。通常写成 6 组十六进制，如 00:1A:2B:3C:4D:5E。用途还包括 MAC address filtering（保安）。

A switch connects devices to form a LAN and directs incoming data to destination devices based on their MAC address.
Data buffering (data caching) in a switch prevents data collision。是 multiport device。

Connects directly to a wired LAN (normally Ethernet) and provides wireless connection to other devices through Wi-Fi to form a wireless LAN (WLAN).
  • 每个 AP 以 SSID（公开的无线网络名称）识别
  • 启用加密则需 data encryption key (password)
  • Administrator 可 limit the maximum number of concurrent users 以控制流量、保持表现

All APs in the same network should have the same SSID. 设备由一个 AP 覆盖范围移到另一个时，wireless NIC 会自动断开原 AP 并连上另一个 → seamlessly switched（无缝切换）。
延伸：Mesh Wi-Fi 用多部 home router 作 nodes 互连成网状。

A router connects LANs with each other or connects a LAN with a WAN. It forwards incoming data to destination devices based on the IP address.
互联网上源头与目的地之间有很多 router；主要功能是 determine the next network node（选择路径）。

✗ “Switch controls the network traffic between different networks.”
✓ Switch is a multiport device that manages the flow of data in a LAN (uses MAC address)；Router forwards data packets between two networks (uses IP address)。

Modem = modulator-demodulator，通常由 ISP 提供，用于连接 Internet。Converts between the analog signals from the Internet and the digital signals from computers.
Modulation：把要传送的数字信号与 carrier wave 结合成 analog signal；Demodulation：把收到的 analog signal 转回 digital。
家居连接次序：Computer → Router → Modem → Exchanges (ISP) → Internet。

DSL modem 用传统 copper telephone lines。
ADSL (Asymmetric DSL)：主要家居用，download speed significantly faster than upload，善用带宽。
SDSL (Symmetric DSL)：主要商业用，same upstream and downstream bandwidth（上传需求大，如架设伺服器）。
光纤数据机 / Fibre optic modem (ONT)
Optical Network Terminal (ONT)：converts between light signals and electrical signals，透过 fibre optic 传数据；屋内再以 twisted pair cable 接 router/电脑。
一组 twisted pairs of copper wires，两端为 RJ-45 connector。扭绞的目的：reduce electromagnetic interference (EMI) and crosstalk（相邻线对的噪音）。最长约 100 metres（更远需 repeater 或改用光纤）。

CableProsCons
UTP (Unshielded, 4 pairs)Lower cost；easier to install<100 m；affected by EMI
STP (Shielded：每对外有金属屏蔽)Faster than UTP；less affected by EMI/crosstalk，更稳定Higher cost；<100 m
光纤电缆 / Fibre optic cable

一组 silica wires (optical fibre)，用光传数据，原理 total internal reflection（core 比 cladding 密，光以大于 critical angle 入射被全反射）。
Pros：fastest transmission speed；not affected by EMI（数据流失少）；less distance restriction；thinner and lighter。用于 WAN、submarine cables。
Cons：highest cost；hard to install；vulnerable to mechanical damage（弯折会断）。测试：visual fault locator (VFL) 注入可见光，若漏光即损坏。

Can build a network connection in remote areas where wired connection is not accessible（如海上、山区；Starlink）。
Cons：installation cost 及 monthly fee extremely expensive；稳定性受 bad weather (rainstorms, windstorms) and sunspot activities 影响；latency 较高。频段由 ITU 分配以免干扰。

需要 a straight connection (line of sight) between a microwave terminal and the access point on top of a building。
Cons：stability easily affected by the weather；中间不能有阻挡物。

Wi-Fi is a wireless data transmission technology based on IEEE 802.11 standards（用 radio waves）。厚墙等障碍物会大大减低覆盖范围。
2.4 GHz5 GHz
SpeedSlowerFaster
RangeLongerShorter
Radio interferenceMoreLess
2.4 GHz 干扰源：microwave ovens、mobile phones、Bluetooth。Dual band router 同时支持两者。

Used for short-distance wireless data transmission between mobile devices（耳机、手柄、smart band）。用 radio waves，operates at 2.4 GHz（可能干扰 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi）。
Popular due to convenience and high compatibility；low power consumption；supports peer-to-peer / multipoint connection。Wi-Fi 数据率高，但连 peripherals 多用 Bluetooth。

Distance；obstacles between two devices；signal interference from surroundings；weather；direction of antenna。
USB cable 比无线：higher data transfer rate、better security、less interference (stable)。

5G and Wi-Fi 6 provide higher data transfer rate to support new applications, and connect more users and devices to increase network capacity。三大特点：High throughput、Low latency、High capacity。
Wi-Fi 6 = 802.11ax（2.4/5 GHz），larger bandwidth，更多用户同时连线。
带宽 vs 吞吐量 / Bandwidth vs Throughput

Bandwidth：maximum data transfer rate（最大理论值，bps）。
Throughput：actual amount of data successfully transferred in a given time；因 poor signals、bottleneck of bandwidth、network congestion 而低于 bandwidth。
Latency：数据由发出到到达的延迟（ms）。
互联网服务供应商 / ISP
An Internet Service Provider (ISP) is a company that provides services for accessing the Internet. 常见接入方式：broadband connection、leased line、mobile data、Wi-Fi hotspot。
Wired，经 DSL（电话线）、cable 或 fibre（如 FTTH, Fibre To The Home）连接；与其他用户共享 ISP 网络。Bandwidth high，cost moderate，security high，availability high。

A private network that connects to the ISP directly over a dedicated channel which does not share the bandwidth with other users.
Bandwidth highest、security highest、cost highest；availability moderate。more stable and secure，适合银行、大企业。
Wireless，经 cellular network（4G/5G）上网，可随处使用。5G：bandwidth high、cost high、security high、availability high。
Wireless，公众地方的无线接入点（商场、咖啡店）。Bandwidth moderate、cost low（多数免费）、security lowest（任何人可连，可能未加密）、availability low（只限热点范围）。
mc: Which device forwards data to the destination device within a LAN based on its MAC address?
Switch 用 MAC address 在 LAN 内转发；router 用 IP 在网络之间转发。
Which of the following is an advantage of a peer-to-peer network over a client-server network?
Easier to back up data centrally
Lower cost as no server is needed
Easier to keep resource versions consistent
P2P 毋须 server，成本低；其余是 client-server 的优点。
48-bit, changed every time the device connects
MAC address 48-bit，由制造商写入硬件。
Which cable is NOT affected by electromagnetic interference?
光纤用光传送，不受 EMI 影响。
To achieve Wi-Fi roaming in a school, all access points should
Roaming 要求同一网络所有 AP 用相同 SSID。
Which statement about 5 GHz Wi-Fi compared with 2.4 GHz is correct?
5 GHz 较快、范围较短、干扰较少；Bluetooth 用 2.4 GHz。
A company needs the most stable and secure dedicated Internet connection with the highest bandwidth. It should choose
Leased line 专用频道、不与他人共享，bandwidth 与 security 最高。
A family mostly downloads videos and seldom uploads. Which modem is most suitable?
ADSL download 快于 upload，适合家居。
Which of the following is the function of a modem?
Convert between analog and digital signals
A teacher's computer shares its USB printer to all students. One disadvantage is that
printing is impossible over a LAN
the printer can only be used when the teacher's computer is on
the printer needs its own IP address
打印机经电脑共享，电脑关机就不能用，并会拖慢该电脑。
Which wireless link requires line of sight between the transmitter and the access point on top of a building?
Microwave 需要 line of sight。
Throughput is usually lower than bandwidth because of
Throughput 是实际传输量，受 congestion、信号、瓶颈影响。
sq:
A small design studio with 8 computers wants to share files and one printer.
(a) Suggest whether a client-server or a peer-to-peer network is more suitable and give TWO reasons.
(b) Name the device used to connect the 8 computers to form a LAN and state how it directs data.

(a) Client-server (accept P2P with reasoning): files stored centrally on a file server, easier to back up and recover [1]; better security through user/access management by administrator [1]; easier to keep versions of files consistent [1]. (P2P: lower cost, no server knowledge needed.)
(b) Switch [1]; it forwards incoming data to the destination device according to the MAC address [1].
Compare UTP cable and fibre optic cable for connecting two buildings 500 m apart. State TWO reasons fibre optic is chosen and ONE disadvantage.

Reasons: twisted pair limited to about 100 m while fibre has less distance restriction [1]; fibre is not affected by EMI so less data loss [1]; fastest transmission speed [1].
Disadvantage: highest cost / hard to install / vulnerable to mechanical damage [1].

Mary lives in a flat and uses a home router with 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz Wi-Fi.
(a) Her bedroom is far from the router behind thick walls. Which band should she use? Explain.
(b) Her Bluetooth headphones interfere with her Wi-Fi. Explain why and suggest a fix.

(a) 2.4 GHz [1], because it has a longer range / penetrates obstacles better than 5 GHz [1].
(b) Bluetooth also operates at 2.4 GHz, causing radio interference [1]; switch the laptop to the 5 GHz band [1].

A school wants students to access the Internet anywhere in the campus.
(a) Name the device that provides wireless connection to the wired LAN.
(b) Suggest TWO settings on this device to control network performance/security.
(c) Explain how students keep their connection when walking between classrooms.

(a) Access point [1].
(b) Enable encryption with a data encryption key/password [1]; limit the maximum number of concurrent users [1] (also accept MAC filtering, hide SSID).
(c) Wi-Fi roaming: all APs use the same SSID [1]; the wireless NIC disconnects from the original AP and connects to the nearer AP automatically / seamlessly [1].
Compare broadband connection, mobile data and Wi-Fi hotspot for a student who wants to do online banking in a coffee shop. Which should he avoid and why?

Avoid public Wi-Fi hotspot [1]: lowest security, anyone can connect and data may not be encrypted, so hackers may intercept/monitor data [1]. Use mobile data instead which is more secure / private [1].

cards:
运行在 end systems 的网络应用，让用户沟通与分享资源：email、instant messaging、web conferencing、web browser。
用 Internet 沟通的好处：instant/fast communication, lower cost, supports multimedia messages。

Protocols are sets of rules that specify the format and order of the data that are sent and received between devices. 所有设备须同意同一标准；devices with different OS can communicate using standardised communication protocols（如同人类用共同语言及礼貌开场）。
Internet protocol suite = 在 Internet 传送数据用的一组协议。Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) 与 Internet Protocol (IP) 合称 TCP/IP，规定数据如何在 Internet 传送。

TCP divides data into smaller packets for efficient transmission. The packets are numbered and sent one by one. When all packets arrive at the destination, TCP reassembles the packets back into the original data（依编号重组）。

IP is responsible for the actual transmission of data packets. It adds the (source and) destination address to each packet and selects the path to the destination — the best path, or an alternative path to avoid network congestion。所以同一讯息的 packets 可能走不同路径、不按次序到达。

1. Data division：分成 packets 并加编号
  2. Use of IP address：每个 packet 加 source & destination IP
  3. Routing：选最佳或替代路径
  4. Reassembling：全部到达后重组
为何要把数据分成 packets？
When a data packet is corrupted during transmission, only the corrupted packet (instead of the whole data) needs to be sent again. 亦可让多条路径分流，有效利用网络。

Layer作用
Application用户与应用程式（browser、email client）之间的介面
Transport分成小 packets，加 transport header (TH)（用哪个协议等）→ segment
Network加 network header (NH)（IP addresses），决定实体路径
Data Link把 IP address 对应到 MAC address，在同一网络的相连设备间传送 frames
Physical以 bit streams (1s and 0s) 经 cables 等实体媒介传送
发送端由上而下逐层加 header = encapsulation；接收端由下而上逐层移除 header、重组 packets = decapsulation（reverse process）。

IP addresses are changeable numerical addresses used to identify a device in a network under TCP/IP; each IP address must be unique in the network.
连上 Internet 时，IP 由 ICANN (Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers) 经你的 ISP 分配。每个 packet 带 source IP 与 destination IP（像信封的寄件/收件地址）。
IP 地址 vs MAC 地址

IP address：identifies the location of a device in the network；changeable；logical，由 ISP 分配；router 用它转发。
MAC address：identifies the device (NIC)；48-bit；由制造商写入硬件；switch 用它转发；也用于 MAC address filtering。

A 32-bit numerical address formed by four 8-bit numbers (octets) separated by periods. 范围 0.0.0.0 至 255.255.255.255（每个 octet 0–255）。例：148.7.52.1 = 10010100.00000111.00110100.00000001。
可能地址总数 = 232 ≈ 4.3 billion。
因 IPv4 快将用尽而引入，容纳更多地址。A 128-bit address formed by eight 16-bit numbers separated by colons，用 hexadecimal 表示，范围 0:0:0:0:0:0:0:0 至 FFFF:…:FFFF。总数 2128。例：2025:1ab1:abcd:1025:20b5:a19a:a315:1212。

1. Omit leading zeros in each group：0f20 → f20，0000 → 0
  2. Zero compression：一串连续全零 groups 以 “::” 取代，“::” 只能出现一次；有两串时，通常压缩较长那串
例：2001:0000:0000:0f20:0000:0000:0000:0f10 → 2001:0:0:f20::f10
Windows：Start → cmd → 输入 ipconfig → 显示 IPv4/IPv6 address 等网络资料。
IP 难记，所以用有意义的名字。Domain name is a human-readable and meaningful form of an IP address. 与 IP 一样须在 Internet 上 unique。

A Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) consists of all domain levels in the hierarchy of DNS, each delimited by a period.
www.google.com.：Hostname (www) + Registration name (google) + Top-level domain (com) + 最后的 “.” 是 root domain（通常省略）。一般用户可注册的是 registration name + TLD 部分。
顶级域名 gTLD 与 ccTLD

最右的名字是 top-level domain (TLD)：
gTLD (generic)：based on type of organisation — com (commercial)、edu、gov、org、net (network provider)…
ccTLD (country code)：based on country/region — hk、cn、jp、uk、au…
亦可两者并用：.com.hk、.gov.hk、.edu.hk。
域名注册 / Domain name registrar

Top-level domain registration is accredited by ICANN；再由 ICANN-Accredited Registrars（如 GoDaddy、HKDNR）管理及分配，公众经 domain name registrar 查询及注册。
例：abc.edu.hk、abc.hk、abc.com 是 3 个不同域名需各自注册；mail.abc.com 只是 hostname，毋须另注册。
DNS 伺服器与名称解析

A DNS server is used to translate domain names into IP addresses. This process is called “name resolution”. DNS server 位置以 IP 表示，通常由 ISP 提供；亦有公共 DNS，如 Google Public DNS 8.8.8.8。
类比：手机通讯录（名字 → 电话号码）；也可直接输入号码 = 直接输入 IP。
cmd 输入 nslookup www.google.com.hk（name server lookup）查询 DNS 纪录，取得 IP；在浏览器直接输入该 IP 也能打开网站。一个域名可对应多个 IP。
能用 IP 但不能用域名上网？
Cause：the DNS server is out of service / unreachable（或 DNS 设定错误）——网络本身正常，只是 name resolution 失败。

A Uniform Resource Locator (URL) identifies a specific location of a resource on the Internet（网页、图片、文件、影片）。
http://www.example.hk:80/about/network.html
= Network protocol (http) + FQDN / IP address (www.example.hk) + Port number (80) + Path (/about/network.html)。
Network protocol：client application 与 server 必须遵守的同一套通讯规则，如 http、https、ftp。
A FQDN / IP address is a unique identification of a host on a network. URL 中两者可互换（如 http://142.250.1.1/）。

同一 host 可同时运行多个应用，port number identifies a specific application（像酒店电话的分机号：总机号 = IP，分机 = port）。
省略时浏览器用 HTTP 预设 port 80；HTTPS 为 443；DNS 为 53（well-known / reserved ports）。
Path：the specific location of a resource relative to the root。/about = folder；/network.html = 该 folder 内的文件。若没指明文件名，浏览器预设寻找 index.html。类似电脑 file explorer 的 file path（root、directory、file extension）。
分类：IPv4 / IPv6 / Domain / FQDN / URL / MAC
HTTP is used by the WWW to transfer hypertext documents (web pages) over the Internet. HTTP server (web server) hosts web pages；browser 作 HTTP client 送出 HTTP request，server 回应并传回 hypertext 格式的网页。

HTTPS is a more secure version of HTTP, using Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) encryption (known as Transport Layer Security, TLS). SSL encrypts data during transmission 确保 confidentiality、reliability、privacy；用于交易与私人资料（网上银行）。浏览器显示锁头与 SSL certificate。

1. 输入 URL → FQDN 经 DNS 转成 IP
  2. Browser 向 web server 送 HTTP request：GET = requests a resource；POST = submits data to the server for processing
  3. Server 回 HTTP response（status + 资源）
  4. 收齐后 browser interpret hypertext 并显示网页
200 OK：成功。400 Bad Request；403 Forbidden（无权限）；404 Not Found（资源不存在）；500 Internal Server Error；502 Bad Gateway；503 Service Unavailable；504 Gateway Timeout。4xx = client 端问题，5xx = server 端问题。

三大组件：user agents (email clients)、email servers、email protocols。
SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol) is used to send emails to the email server；email servers 之间亦用 SMTP 传递。

两者皆为 email access protocol，用来从 server 取回邮件。
POP3IMAP
Emails downloaded to the local computerEmails kept on the server
只能下载后在本机整理可在 server 上整理；changes synchronised across devices；多个 clients 存取同一 mailbox
下载后不需 Internet 也能读Needs Internet to read
多部设备 → IMAP；单一设备离线阅读 → POP3。
误解：POP3 下载后一定删除？

✗ POP3 下载后 server 会自动删除邮件。
✓ 预设会删除以节省空间，但 POP3 clients have the option to keep emails on the server。
误解：Web mail 用 IMAP/POP3 收？

✗ IMAP/POP3 are used to receive web mails.
✓ 用 Gmail/Yahoo 网页版时，emails are sent from the mail server to the browser using HTTP/HTTPS。
File Transfer Protocol (FTP)：在网络上传送文件的方法；涉及 file server 与 client，通常需 user authentication（username/password）。FTP client 例：WinSCP。
所有应用协议都建在 TCP/IP 之上
All computers use TCP/IP for communication in the Internet. HTTP, SMTP, POP and IMAP are all application protocols on top of TCP/IP.

sq: Explain how TCP/IP sends a long message from computer X to computer Y over the Internet (4 marks).

TCP divides the message into packets and numbers them [1]; IP adds source and destination IP addresses to each packet [1]; routers select the best/alternative path for each packet to avoid congestion, so packets may travel different routes [1]; TCP at Y reassembles the packets in order when all have arrived (and requests resending of lost/corrupted packets) [1].

Peter types https://www.shop.com.hk/cart/index.html into a browser.
(a) Identify the protocol, FQDN and path.
(b) What is the default port number used?
(c) Describe how the browser obtains the IP address of the server.
(d) Give ONE reason the shop uses HTTPS.

(a) https [1]; www.shop.com.hk [1]; /cart/index.html [1].
(b) 443 [1].
(c) The browser sends the FQDN to a DNS server, which translates it into the IP address (name resolution) and returns it [1].
(d) HTTPS uses SSL/TLS to encrypt data during transmission, so credit card/login data cannot be read if intercepted [1].
Compare IPv4 and IPv6 in terms of number of bits, notation and reason IPv6 was introduced. Then compress 2001:0000:0000:0f20:0000:0000:0000:0f10.

IPv4: 32-bit, four 8-bit decimal numbers separated by periods [1]; IPv6: 128-bit, eight 16-bit hexadecimal groups separated by colons [1]; IPv6 introduced because IPv4 addresses are running out due to growth of Internet devices [1]. Compressed: 2001:0:0:f20::f10 [1].

Alan wants his tutorial school accessible at www.star.edu.hk, www.star.hk and www.star.com.
(a) How many domain names must be registered? Explain.
(b) Does he need to register mail.star.com? Explain.
(c) Where can he register them?

(a) 3 [1]: star.edu.hk, star.hk and star.com are different domain names (different TLDs) [1].
(b) No [1]; 'mail' is only a hostname under the registered domain star.com [1].
(c) Through a domain name registrar accredited by ICANN (e.g. HKDNR, GoDaddy) [1].
A student uses one school desktop for email and wants to read emails offline at home on his laptop only. Recommend POP3 or IMAP and explain. State ONE difference between the two.

POP3 [1]: emails are downloaded to the local computer so they can be read without Internet connection [1]. Difference: POP3 stores/organises emails locally while IMAP keeps emails on the server and synchronises changes across devices [1].

cards:
IoT refers to a network connecting different objects（home appliances、electronic devices、wearables、vehicles）。Connected objects share collected data and provide new functionalities，例：车辆传送速度与位置作实时交通分析。
常用无线技术：Wi-Fi、Bluetooth、RFID、NFC。IoT 每秒产生大量数据，靠 cloud computing 即时储存及处理。
云端 / Cloud services 的好处

The cloud simply means the Internet. Everything in the cloud is stored in remote servers hosted by a third party and accessible through the Internet. 用户毋须升级硬件或安装多个软件。
好处：Accessibility（anywhere anytime）、Flexibility（on-demand 改 service plan）、Maintenance（由 provider 负责）。

类型功能例子
Operating system (virtual machines)在更强的 virtual machines 运行工作Microsoft Azure、Google Compute Engine
Storage数据存放在第三方 remote serversGoogle Drive、OneDrive、iCloud
Hosted application直接在 cloud server 开启使用软件Google Docs Editors、Office 365
小组用 USB 轮流传、或放学碰面由一人打字 → 慢、版本混乱。用 cloud-based document editing（Google Docs）→ share and co-edit files in real time、自动保存版本、毋须见面。

Cloud-based IoT applications have enabled smart cities. A smart city is a complex system of systems：利用 IoT 收集的数据并以 AI 作决策，to make better decisions and improve quality of life by addressing urbanisation challenges（environmental sustainability、traffic congestion、waste management…）。
香港六大范畴：Smart Economy、Smart Living、Smart Mobility、Smart Environment、Smart People、Smart Government。
智慧经济：网上银行与支付

Online banking：随时查看最新交易、转账，毋须等月结单。
Online payment platforms（PayPal、FPS 转数快、PPS）：可增值 digital wallet 或连信用卡/银行户口。
Contactless payment：rechargeable smart cards (NFC)、credit/debit cards、mobile wallets (NFC、QR code)。
只收电子支付的缺点：排斥用现金的顾客、widen digital divide。

Instant messaging、video conferencing、cloud collaboration、remote logon 令员工可在家工作。
Pros：雇主 cheaper rent & operating costs；员工省交通时间、弹性。
Cons：雇主 risks of data breaches due to insecure connections outside office；员工需自付 workstation、Internet 等成本，工作生活界线模糊。
智慧生活、政府、交通、教育、环境例子

Living/Government：HA Go app、My Library app、iAM Smart（一站式登入政府服务、digital signing）。
Mobility：Free-flow Tolling System 不停车缴费、新一代停车咪表（实时车位、网上缴费）、real-time arrival information、real-time adaptive traffic signal。
People/Education：remote learning、online resources、real-time evaluation（自动批改）。
Environment：智能街灯、fill-level sensors 规划收垃圾路线、监测用电、水质与空气。

Messages sent through the Internet. 与 instant messaging 比：email is cross-platform（任何 browser/app、任何 provider 之间都可收发）、正式、适合职场、可附大量文件、保存记录。
Email address = username + @ + domain name（mail server）。

FieldFeatureApplication
To原本收件人需主要收件人 take action / pay attention
Cc (Carbon copy)地址显示在 message header；其他人知道有副本给他Send a copy for information only
Bcc (Blind carbon copy)Header hides 这些地址；其他人不知道他收到不让别人知道还有谁收到；best practice for bulk mail to protect recipients' privacy

Reply：只回原寄件人。Reply All：回寄件人及所有 To 和 Cc 收件人（Bcc 收件人不会收到）。Forward：把讯息（含 attachments，除非手动移除）转给新收件人；转发内容只显示 To/Cc，Bcc 不会被披露。
Bcc 的缺点：被排除于之后的讨论。

方法特点适用
Attachment占 mailbox 空间；有 size limitSmall files, e.g. text
Inline embedding直接显示于 message body；多数只支援图片；有些 client 不自动载入图片Images
HyperlinkSize limit 大得多；不占 mailbox 空间（占 cloud 空间）Large files, e.g. videos
Hyperlink：pros 邮件细、传输少；cons link may become invalid if files are removed，或需权限。

Provider 以 AI 侦测并阻挡多数 spam；用户可 mark as spam / not spam 提高准确度；用 whitelist（safe senders）及 blacklist（block senders）。
不自动显示陌生寄件人的图片：spammers 可借图片被下载计算 open rate，亦可能藏 malware。

Remote logon (remote access) is the method to remotely access a device from another device，让 authorised users 远距连接甚至控制设备。最常用 remote desktop software（AnyDesk、Chrome Remote Desktop），通常 cross-platform。安全版本应有 authentication、VPN、encryption。
远程登入的好处与限制

Benefits：use software licensed to a specific computer；run resource-intensive programs on a more powerful computer；access files on other computers anytime anywhere；IT support 远程协助。
Limitations：data breach may occur during transmission；需双方都连网；网络差/RAM 不足 → high latency。
必要条件：both computers run the same remote desktop software。保安：encryption、2FA/one-time access code（Chrome Remote Desktop 码 5 分钟有效、需 PIN ≥6 位）。

Online chat enables private conversation with an individual or a group of people using different types of multimedia（text、audio、images、video、stickers）。形式：SNS 的 direct messages、instant messaging apps（含 voice/video call）、customer service online messaging。

Online platforms where people can ask and answer questions or share content related to a certain topic（message boards）。例：Reddit、Quora、Stack Exchange、Uwants、Baby Kingdom；LMS 的 forum 增加教学互动。帖子可 upvote、分类。

Social Networking Sites (social media) enable people to stay connected by sharing experiences and ideas in digital media（texts、images、audio、video）；与朋友保持联系，并与 similar interests 的人建立关系。另有 blogs（由 online diary 演变）。
风险：privacy leakage、假资讯、phishing、过度使用。
网上文件传输方法比较

考虑 file size、file format、security。
MethodFormatSize limitEncryption
Instant messaging图片/影片会 automatic compressionSmall通常 end-to-end
EmailNo restrictionsSmall只当双方 provider 支援
Cloud storageNo restrictionsLarge部分支援，较低
Network drive over VPNNo restrictions视乎 local storageYes
P2P file sharingNo restrictions视乎 local storageNo
要传原画质影片 → 不用 IM（会被压缩），用 cloud link。

Search engines are widely used for searching information on the WWW（Google、Yahoo!、Bing）。输入 keyword 后，程式在其 index 中找相关网页并排序。
SEO (Search Engine Optimisation)：improving website traffic by increasing rankings and visibility in search results，数码营销很重要。
搜寻引擎 vs 数据库

Search engineDatabase
Content can change anytimePublished content that does not change
Contributed by any Internet usersEvaluated for accuracy by publishers
多数免费常需订阅（学校/图书馆）
Databases are a more reliable source for academic research.

1. Choose keywords（可用 synonyms / related keywords；字词愈多愈具体，结果愈少）
  2. Choose source types（Images、Videos、News…，配合 filters：size、colour、publish date、usage rights、duration…）
  3. Use Boolean logic
  4. Refine your search

TechniqueOperatorExample
Exclude results- 在关键字前apple -fruit
Combine keywordsORmandarin orange OR tangerine

评估网上资讯：Reliability / Credibility / Timeliness

任何人都可发布 → 可能 inaccurate、out of date、incomplete。
Reliability：与其他来源一致吗？来源清楚吗？→ verify with other sources、check broken links。
Credibility：作者够资格吗？→ check the domains（.gov、.org、.edu）、search for information on the author。
Timeliness：够新吗？→ check the publish date、更新频率。
Unnecessary panic（如 2011 日本核事故抢购盐）、reputational damage、monetary loss、distrust in media；他人因错误资讯作出错误决定。查证：找 primary source、比对官方网站、reverse image search、Google Fact Check 标签。
Internet vs 图书馆作资讯来源

Internet 优点：anywhere anytime、more likely to be up to date、搜寻快、可比较多个来源。
✗ 网上资讯 not copyrighted / free to use（错）；✗ 只有专家能发布（错）。

Multimedia（text、graphics、animation、video、audio）deliver ideas more easily、attract users to stay longer、support different learning styles and disabilities。
Lossless compression offers the best quality but uses much more data and slows loading → 应选适当格式以缩小文件、加快传输。

• JPG：lossy，fairly small，最兼容；photos
  • PNG：lossless，fairly large；transparent background、screenshots、带文字的图
  • GIF：256 colours，animation，简单动图
  • APNG：lossless animated（stickers）
  • WebP：smaller with same visible quality；支援 transparency/animation；新浏览器
  • SVG：vector，放大不失真，适合 icons/logos 跨解像度
  • AVIF：较新 open-source，更细同画质；支援度较低
SWF（Flash）已于 2020 年底停止支援。

Raster/bitmap（JPG、PNG、GIF、WebP）：由 pixels 组成，放大会 pixelated；适合 photos。
Vector（SVG）：以数学形状描述，scales without losing quality、文件小；适合 icons、logos，不适合照片。

• MP3：lossy，most compatible，relatively small
  • AAC：lossy，better sound quality at lower bitrate；streaming（YouTube Music）
  • OGG：lossy，open-source
  • FLAC / ALAC：lossless，large；高质无损音乐串流
  • WAV：uncompressed，very large；原始档案
一般聆听 lossy 已足够（难分差异）。上传到平台再转码时，应上传 lossless/最高质（如 FLAC）；慢网用户提供低 bitrate（如 AAC/OGG 96kbps）。

Codec = encoding and decoding scheme。影片文件大 → 需较高 bandwidth、载入慢，选适当格式可保质量、流畅播放并节省传输成本。
MP4（H.264/H.265）：most compatible。WebM（VP9/AV1）：open-source，file size smaller than H.264 with similar quality，但支援较少。网站常同时提供 WebM 与 MP4 → 不支援 WebM 的浏览器可 fall back to MP4。
AVI：大、网页不宜；FLV 已淘汰。

A plug-in (add-on / extension) is a program that extends the browser or OS to support extra formats, codecs or functionality. 浏览器不支援某格式（如 AVIF）时可能改为下载档案。
应 keep plug-ins and browsers up-to-date 以修补 security vulnerabilities。
Software designed for the playback of audio and video files（Windows Media Player、Groove Music、VLC、QuickTime）。可下载后离线播放；缺少相应 codec 会播放失败 → 需更新或安装 codec。
手机数据用得快的原因
自动经 cellular 备份相片、浏览大量影片/图片的社交网站、看高画质串流、听 lossless music。

Streaming is a technology for delivering media over the Internet with a continuous flow of data. Users can play and download the media simultaneously → 等候时间缩短。
Client 端有 buffer：已播放数据（播完移除）│ current playback position │ buffer (loaded data) │ 未载入。

Streaming pros：play in real time without downloading the entire file；不储存整个文件 → saves storage space；较难被复制（版权）。
Cons：does not support offline playback；bandwidth limits quality/smoothness（buffering、lag）。
Live stream：实时直播（体育、游戏、直播购物）。考虑：uploading bandwidth、bitrate、formats & codecs、resolution、平台。用现成 webcasting 平台 → 省开发时间成本，用户毋须安装额外 app（browser 即可）。
Voice calls：real-time，像电话（VoIP, Voice over IP）。Voice messaging：deliver and receive messages anytime，代替文字讯息；音频被分割及压缩成较小文件。
视像会议 vs 网上广播

Video conferencingWebcasting
Number of viewersHundreds or relatively smallUnlimited / fairly large
MediaReal-timeReal-time or pre-recorded
CommunicationTwo-way，more interaction（screen sharing）Mainly one-way（可开 live comments）
PrivacyPrivate eventsPublic events
Webcasting = broadcasting live or pre-recorded audio/video over the Internet.
影响串流质素的技术因素

Media format、codec、bitrate、resolution、frame rate、network bandwidth、Internet connection (stability)、server。
The better the quality, the larger the file size → 低带宽时出现 latency and pixelisation、buffering。
Resolution 高 → 细节清晰但需更多带宽；Frame rate 高 → 动作流畅但数据多。Adaptive streaming 按用户网速自动给最佳质素。
Live streaming 的 low-latency mode：观众留言与主播回应几乎同步，适合游戏直播互动；代价是 buffer 少 → 网络不稳时较易卡顿。Normal latency：buffer 多 → 更流畅但延迟大。

sq: Explain how IoT and cloud computing work together in a smart city. Give ONE example in Smart Mobility and ONE in Smart Environment.

IoT devices/sensors collect large amounts of data and send it over the Internet [1]; cloud computing stores and processes the data instantly (with AI) so systems can take actions/make decisions [1]. Mobility: real-time adaptive traffic signals / real-time arrival info / Free-flow Tolling [1]. Environment: bin fill-level sensors to plan collection routes / smart street lighting / air-quality monitoring [1].

John wants to use his school's 3D modelling software from home via remote logon.
(a) Give TWO benefits.
(b) State ONE setup needed.
(c) Suggest ONE security measure the remote desktop software should have.
(d) He experiences high latency. Suggest ONE cause.

(a) Use software licensed to the school computer without extra fee [1]; run resource-intensive program on a more powerful computer/GPU [1] (or access files anytime).
(b) The same remote desktop software must run on both computers / school computer on and connected [1].
(c) Encryption of transmitted data / 2FA or one-time access code [1].
(d) Poor Internet connection / low bandwidth / running out of RAM [1].

Eva finds a web page saying 'Placing onions in the room prevents flu'. Describe how she should evaluate reliability, credibility and timeliness before sharing it, and state ONE possible impact of spreading false information.

Reliability: verify the information with other (official) sources / check sources are cited [1]. Credibility: check the domain (.gov/.edu/.org) and the author's qualification [1]. Timeliness: check the publish date / recent updates [1]. Impact: unnecessary panic / others make wrong decisions / monetary loss / distrust in media [1].

A school will live-stream its talent show.
(a) Explain what streaming is and the role of the buffer.
(b) State TWO technical factors to consider.
(c) Give ONE reason to use an existing webcasting platform.

(a) Media is delivered as a continuous flow of data so users can play while downloading [1]; the buffer stores loaded data ahead of the playback position so playback continues smoothly despite network fluctuation [1].
(b) Upload bandwidth of school network / bitrate / resolution / frame rate / codec and format (any two) [2].
(c) Saves time and cost of developing an app / viewers need no extra installation, just a browser [1].
Compare sending a holiday video to a friend through instant messaging and through a cloud storage link in terms of quality, size limit and security.

Quality: IM automatically compresses images/videos so quality drops; cloud keeps original quality [1]. Size limit: IM small; cloud storage large [1]. Security: IM messages usually end-to-end encrypted; cloud links have relatively lower security / anyone with the link may access [1].
